name: IPS Conservation Grants
summary: Small grants for primate conservation field programmes and applied research with conservation impact, with an extra award for community conservation components. Basic research or education-only proposals are excluded.

amount.note: Plus an additional $500 community conservation award possible

eligibility.rule: Applicant is a member of the International Primatological Society
Past awardees have submitted a report on their previous award
Proposal is not focused solely on basic research or education

status.quote: Application Deadline is annually on March 1st

recurring.quote: Application Deadline is annually on March 1st

access.quote: The Conservation Committee of IPS is soliciting applications of up to $1,500 to support the development of primate conservation field programs

window.quote: Application Deadline is annually on March 1st

amount.quote: soliciting applications of up to $1,500 to support the development of primate conservation field programs and/or applied research with impact on primate conservation. If you plan to include community conservation in your program, you may be eligible for an additional Conservation through Community Involvement (CCI) award of $500.

effort.quote: Application Deadline is annually on March 1st

eligibility.quote: Only IPS members can apply for IPS grants.
Past awardees are eligible to reapply as long as you have submitted a report on your previous award.
We do not consider proposals for projects focusing solely on basic research or education.

after_award.quote: When submitting your grant report please use the following template
we will review a follow-up application only if you have submitted your final report for any previous award
